profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amazon Leo

positions.title: Senior Test Engineer
positions.description: Designs automated test equipment for Solta products. Test station development includes software development (C#/VB.NET, Microsoft SQL Server), electrical design (OrCAD Capture), and mechanical design (Creo Pro/E). Analyses and qualifies equipment statistically to include gage repeatability and reproducibility and failure modes and effects analysis.

positions.title: Automation and Test Engineer
positions.description: Designed and supported automated test equipment for Honeywell's precision accelerometer Redmond manufacturing facility to include software development (Visual Studio .NET applications and drivers, microcontroller/DSP firmware in C, Oracle PL/SQL), electrical circuit and PCB design (OrCAD Capture, Allegro PCB Editor) and test station hardware design (Autodesk Inventor). Six Sigma Green Belt certified.

positions.title: Shift Engineer - S8G Prototype
positions.description: Led a crew of 100 nuclear-trained operators at the S8G prototype reactor plant in all aspects of operations, maintenance, and training. Leveraged at-sea submarine experience to mentor, train, and develop staff and student Navy nuclear operators.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Officer - USS Michigan
positions.description: Led personnel from multiple technical disciplines to ensure first-time quality maintenance on seawater, steam, hydraulic, and compressed air systems vital to submarine and diver’s safety. Served as the Commanding Officer’s direct representative to certify safe test depth operations after every in-port period with 100% accuracy. Maintained a high level of crew readiness through effective ship-wide quality assurance audit, surveillance, and training programs.

positions.title: Strike and Special Operations Forces Officer - USS Michigan
positions.description: Led 25 technicians in the preventative and corrective maintenance of greater than $100 million of Tomahawk strike and special operations equipment. Ensured critical equipment maintained and operated effectively to support Michigan’s primary missions.
